mapper.delete: DELETE FROM performance_wishlist WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND performance_id = #{performanceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_wishlist WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND performance_id = #{performanceId}

SELECT w.*, p.title AS performanceTitle, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, p.venue_name AS venueName, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate FROM performance_wishlist w JOIN performance p ON w.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_wishlist WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId}
